title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：IPO首日不碰，等锁定期后再看
speaker: Adam Gold

segments.en: Or how long would one wait? What would be your leading indicators, whether or not it is a good time to get into?
segments.zh: 或者要等多久？你的领先指标是什么，判断是否适合入场？

segments.en: That's an example, a name like anthropic, and this massive debut.
segments.zh: 举个例子，像Anthropic这样的名字，以及这次大规模亮相。

segments.en: Sure, I've been doing this since I was 18 years old professionally.
segments.zh: 当然，我从18岁起就专业从事这个行业。

segments.en: I'm 43 now, I have three young children. And I've learned my lesson on IPOs.
segments.zh: 我现在43岁，有三个年幼的孩子。我在IPO上吸取了教训。

segments.en: You wait until the lockups expire. There's explorations on lockups happen, because they're going to be more staged here like they were with SpaceX.
segments.zh: 你要等到锁定期结束。锁定期会有分阶段释放，因为这里会像SpaceX那样分阶段进行。

segments.en: We don't have to wait exactly till 180 days, but you certainly want to wait till more shares are available.
segments.zh: 我们不必精确等到180天，但你肯定想等到更多份额可用。

segments.en: Private markets are one sided. It's whoever gives them the most money for the lease ownership.
segments.zh: 私募市场是单边的。谁出价最高获得租赁所有权，就是谁。

segments.en: That equals the quote valuation. And that's clearly not true.
segments.zh: 那等于报价估值。而这显然不真实。

segments.en: A valuation is based upon two sided markets, buyers and sellers.
segments.zh: 估值基于双边市场，买方和卖方。

segments.en: So we don't like to buy on day one. We have a lot of patience.
segments.zh: 所以我们不喜欢第一天就买入。我们很有耐心。

segments.en: We'll wait a few months. We'll wait till there's a few earnings calls.
segments.zh: 我们会等几个月，等到几次财报电话会议之后。

segments.en: We'll see how they guide. We'll see how the stock reacts.
segments.zh: 我们会看他们如何指引，看市场如何反应。

segments.en: But we don't like to judge companies on day one investments.
segments.zh: 但我们不喜欢凭第一天的表现判断公司。

segments.en: We like to judge them on year 10. And so we have a multi decade year holding period.
segments.zh: 我们喜欢以第十年的眼光判断，因此持有周期长达数十年。

segments.en: Those are our favorite companies, the ones like Apple on the video.
segments.zh: 那些是我们最青睐的公司，就像视频里的苹果。

segments.en: We've owned those for over decades now. And our goal is to kind of continue to look for great investments.
segments.zh: 我们持有这些公司已超过几十年，目标是继续寻找优质权益资产。

segments.en: We think anthropic might be a great compounding company in the future.
segments.zh: 我们认为Anthropic未来可能成为一家伟大的复利型公司。

segments.en: There's a lot of questions that we'll have to get answers to. But you know, two trillion dollars on day one.
segments.zh: 有很多问题需要找到答案，但你知道，第一天就两万亿美元。

segments.en: We're not interested in that kind of investment.
segments.zh: 我们对那种配置不感兴趣。

segments.en: You mentioned you've been holders of a video for some time now.
segments.zh: 你提到你们持有某视频公司已有一段时间。
